description: This file contains a script for managing GitHub discussions and comments related to translation pull requests in a FastAPI project. It interacts with GitHub's GraphQL API, handles labels, discussions, and comments to notify reviewers and mark completion.

classes.name: Comment
classes.description: Model representing a GitHub comment with id, url, and body.

classes.name: UpdateDiscussionComment
classes.description: Model for updating a discussion comment, contains a Comment.

classes.name: UpdateCommentData
classes.description: Wrapper for updateDiscussionComment response data.

classes.name: UpdateCommentResponse
classes.description: Response model for updating a comment.

classes.name: AddDiscussionComment
classes.description: Model for adding a discussion comment, contains a Comment.

classes.name: AddCommentData
classes.description: Wrapper for addDiscussionComment response data.

classes.name: AddCommentResponse
classes.description: Response model for adding a comment.

classes.name: CommentsEdge
classes.description: Represents an edge in comments connection with node (Comment) and cursor.

classes.name: Comments
classes.description: Contains list of CommentsEdge.

classes.name: CommentsDiscussion
classes.description: Contains Comments.

classes.name: CommentsRepository
classes.description: Contains CommentsDiscussion.

classes.name: CommentsData
classes.description: Contains CommentsRepository.

classes.name: CommentsResponse
classes.description: Top-level response model for comments GraphQL query.

classes.name: AllDiscussionsLabelNode
classes.description: Represents a label node with id and name.

classes.name: AllDiscussionsLabelsEdge
classes.description: Edge containing a label node.

classes.name: AllDiscussionsDiscussionLabels
classes.description: Contains list of label edges.

classes.name: AllDiscussionsDiscussionNode
classes.description: Discussion node with title, id, number, and labels.

classes.name: AllDiscussionsDiscussions
classes.description: Contains list of discussion nodes.

classes.name: AllDiscussionsRepository
classes.description: Contains discussions.

classes.name: AllDiscussionsData
classes.description: Contains repository data.

classes.name: AllDiscussionsResponse
classes.description: Top-level response model for discussions GraphQL query.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Configuration settings for the script, including GitHub repository info, token, and runtime options.

classes.name: PartialGitHubEventIssue
classes.description: Partial model for GitHub pull request event with optional number.

classes.name: PartialGitHubEvent
classes.description: Partial model for GitHub event with optional pull request.

methods.name: get_graphql_response
methods.description: Sends a GraphQL request to GitHub API with provided query and variables, returns response data.

methods.name: get_graphql_translation_discussions
methods.description: Fetches all translation discussions from GitHub.

methods.name: get_graphql_translation_discussion_comments_edges
methods.description: Fetches comment edges for a specific discussion.

methods.name: get_graphql_translation_discussion_comments
methods.description: Retrieves all comments for a discussion, handling pagination.

methods.name: create_comment
methods.description: Creates a new comment in a discussion.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function that manages PR labels, discussions, and comments for translation review workflow.
